frappe.name: call
frappe.returnDescription: Promise that resolves with server response r.message.
frappe.docstring: Sends an AJAX request to execute a whitelisted backend Python function on the server.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Configuration options object for backend RPC call.

frappe.name: xcall
frappe.returnDescription: Promise resolving directly to r.message payload.
frappe.docstring: Modern Promise-based shorthand for `frappe.call`. Can be directly `await`ed in async JavaScript functions.

parameters.name: args
parameters.description: Arguments payload dictionary passed to backend method.

frappe.signature: frappe.__(text: string, replace_args?: string[], context?: string): string
frappe.returnDescription: Translated string in the active user's language.
frappe.docstring: Translates text into the user's active session language.
frappe.example:
const label = __("Submit Salary Slip");
const greeting = __("Hello {0}", [user_name]);

frappe.name: msgprint
frappe.signature: frappe.msgprint(msg: string | object, title?: string, indicator?: string): void
frappe.docstring: Displays a popup modal message dialog to the user in the desk.

frappe.name: show_alert
frappe.signature: frappe.show_alert(message: string | object, seconds?: number): void
frappe.docstring: Shows a floating toast notification in the bottom right corner of the browser.

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: Toast notification message string or options object with message and indicator.

parameters.name: seconds
parameters.description: Display duration in seconds before auto-dismissing.

frappe.name: throw
frappe.docstring: Displays a red error modal dialog and stops JavaScript execution.

frappe.name: confirm
frappe.signature: frappe.confirm(message: string, if_yes: () => void, if_no?: () => void): void
frappe.docstring: Displays a Yes / No confirmation dialog before executing an action.
frappe.example: frappe.confirm(__("Are you sure you want to reset this form?"), () => frm.reload_doc());

parameters.name: message
parameters.structure: __("Are you sure you want to proceed?")

parameters.name: if_yes
parameters.description: Callback executed when user clicks Yes / Confirm.

parameters.name: if_no
parameters.description: Callback executed when user clicks No / Cancel.

frappe.name: prompt
frappe.signature: frappe.prompt(fields: object | object[], callback: (values: any) => void, title?: string, primary_action_label?: string): void
frappe.docstring: Renders a quick input dialog with one or more fields to collect user input.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Single field definition or list of DocField definition objects.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Callback invoked with form input values upon submission.

frappe.name: show_progress
frappe.signature: frappe.show_progress(title: string, count: number, total: number, description?: string): void
frappe.docstring: Displays or updates a progress bar popup dialog on screen.

frappe.name: hide_progress
frappe.docstring: Closes and dismisses the progress bar dialog.

frappe.name: provide
frappe.docstring: Initializes a nested object namespace on the global window object (e.g. `frappe.provide('my_app.utils')`).

frappe.name: set_route
frappe.returnDescription: Promise resolving when route transition completes.
frappe.docstring: Navigates the desk UI to the specified route (e.g. Form, List, Tree, Page).

frappe.name: show_modal
frappe.docstring: Displays a desk modal popup with HTML content.

parameters.name: options
parameters.description: Modal configuration object with title, content HTML, and optional footer.

frappe.web_form.name: on
frappe.web_form.docstring: Registers an event listener or field change handler on a website public Web Form.

frappe.web_form.name: set_value
frappe.web_form.docstring: Sets the value of a field on the public Web Form and updates the input control.

frappe.web_form.name: get_value
frappe.web_form.returnDescription: Current value of field on Web Form.
frappe.web_form.docstring: Retrieves the current value entered in a Web Form field.

frappe.web_form.name: set_df_property
frappe.web_form.docstring: Dynamically modifies a field property on the Web Form ('read_only', 'reqd', 'hidden').

frappe.listview_settings.name: add_fields
frappe.listview_settings.docstring: List of additional database fields to fetch for each row in the ListView.

frappe.listview_settings.name: get_indicator
frappe.listview_settings.signature: get_indicator(doc: object) -> [label: string, color: string, filter: string]
frappe.listview_settings.docstring: Returns a tuple [Label, Color, FilterCondition] to render a colored status indicator pill in ListView.

frappe.listview_settings.name: onload
frappe.listview_settings.docstring: Lifecycle hook triggered once when the ListView finishes loading.

frappe.db.name: get_value
frappe.db.signature: frappe.db.get_value(doctype: string, filters: string | object, fieldname: string | string[]) -> Promise<{ message: object }>
frappe.db.returnDescription: Promise resolving with the requested field values dictionary.
frappe.db.docstring: Fetches field values for a record from the server database without reloading the page.

parameters.name: filters
parameters.description: Document ID name or filter object.

parameters.name: fieldname
parameters.description: Field name or array of field names to fetch.

frappe.db.name: get_doc
frappe.db.returnDescription: Promise resolving with full document object.
frappe.db.docstring: Fetches a full document object with child tables from the server.

frappe.db.name: set_value
frappe.db.signature: frappe.db.set_value(doctype: string, name: string, fieldname: string | object, value?: any): Promise<any>
frappe.db.docstring: Directly updates a field or fields on a server database record from client-side JavaScript without loading the document form.

parameters.name: fieldname
parameters.description: Fieldname to update or object containing multiple field-value pairs.

parameters.name: value
parameters.description: Value to write (omit if fieldname is an object).

frappe.db.name: count
frappe.db.returnDescription: Promise resolving with total record count number.
frappe.db.docstring: Counts matching records in the database table.

frappe.ui.Dialog.name: show
frappe.ui.Dialog.docstring: Opens and renders the dialog popup modal on screen.
frappe.ui.Dialog.example:
const d = new frappe.ui.Dialog({ title: __("Title"), fields: [...] });
d.show();

frappe.ui.Dialog.name: hide
frappe.ui.Dialog.docstring: Closes and hides the dialog popup modal.

frappe.ui.Dialog.name: get_values
frappe.ui.Dialog.returnDescription: Dictionary of field values, or null if mandatory validation fails.
frappe.ui.Dialog.docstring: Validates inputs and returns all user-entered field values as a key-value object.

frappe.ui.Dialog.name: set_value
frappe.ui.Dialog.docstring: Sets the value of a specific field inside the dialog input form.

frappe.datetime.name: nowdate
frappe.datetime.docstring: Returns today's date formatted as a 'YYYY-MM-DD' string.

frappe.datetime.name: add_days
frappe.datetime.docstring: Adds or subtracts N days from a date string.

frappe.datetime.name: prettyDate
frappe.datetime.docstring: Formats a timestamp into human-readable relative duration.

frappe.model.name: get_value
frappe.model.signature: frappe.model.get_value(doctype: string, name: string, fieldname: string) -> any
frappe.model.docstring: Retrieves field value from client in-memory cache (frappe.locals).

frappe.model.name: set_value
frappe.model.signature: frappe.model.set_value(cdt: string, cdn: string, fieldname: string | object, value?: any): Promise<any>
frappe.model.returnDescription: Promise that resolves once client scripts and formulas have recalculated.
frappe.model.docstring: Updates a field value on a child table row or memory document, triggering all client-side event handlers and formula recalculations. Always use `frappe.model.set_value` inside child table triggers instead of setting `row.qty = 5` directly.

parameters.name: cdn
parameters.description: Unique Child Document Name / row ID (cdn).

parameters.name: fieldname
parameters.description: Fieldname string OR dictionary of multiple field key-value pairs.

frappe.realtime.name: on
frappe.realtime.signature: frappe.realtime.on(event: string, callback: (data: any) => void): void
frappe.realtime.docstring: Listens to real-time WebSocket events published from backend Python workers (`frappe.publish_realtime`). Enables live UI updates without refreshing the browser.

parameters.name: event
parameters.description: Event name emitted from Python backend via `frappe.publish_realtime`.

parameters.name: callback
parameters.description: Function executed when WebSocket event payload arrives.

frappe.ui.form.name: on
frappe.ui.form.docstring: Main entry point for all Frappe Client Scripts. Registers event listeners for form lifecycle events (`onload`, `refresh`, `validate`, `before_save`, `on_submit`) and field change triggers on parent and child DocTypes.

parameters.name: doctype
parameters.description: DocType name to attach listeners to.

parameters.name: handlers
parameters.description: Object dictionary mapping event names and fieldnames to callback functions.

frappe.router.name: set_route
frappe.router.returnDescription: Promise resolved when router navigation finishes.
frappe.router.docstring: Navigates the Frappe Single Page App to the given route.

frappe.router.name: get_route
frappe.router.docstring: Returns the current active router path segments as an array.

frappe.router.name: get_route_str
frappe.router.docstring: Returns the current active route joined with slashes.

frappe.utils.name: copy_to_clipboard
frappe.utils.docstring: Copies text to user's system clipboard and displays a desk notification toast.

frappe.utils.name: play_sound
frappe.utils.docstring: Plays a desk audio alert sound ('submit', 'cancel', 'error', 'click', 'email').

frappe.utils.name: get_form_link
frappe.utils.docstring: Generates an HTML hyperlink tag pointing directly to a document in desk.
